subject: 28 days of Loud EQ
preview_text: See what your audio setup has been quietly doing for you this month
body_paragraphs: A month ago you downloaded Loud EQ. That means roughly 420 commutes, 56 hours of podcasts, or 28 audiobook chapters—all without straining to hear a single line. You've been running our auto-tune every time you plug in, and the hearing-safe streak has been watching your back. That's not just progress, it's momentum.

Most people don't realize how much they were missing until they look back. The road noise that used to bury dialogue? Gone. The constant volume wrestling on the subway? Automated. Your ears have been running at a safer level, and you've been getting every word clear. This is what an optimized setup feels like after a month—it becomes invisible.

Here's the thing: Premium users get something extra after 28 days. Sound DNA calibration adapts to your specific headphones and your hearing profile, fine-tuning the EQ so it's not just loud, but perfectly tailored. It's like having an audio engineer ride along with you, adjusting everything in real time.

Open Loud EQ now and tap Optimize to see your month-in-review stats. Then check out the Sound DNA trial to see how much clearer it can get. P.S. Your hearing-safe streak is still active—keep it going, and you'll hit a full month of safer listening tomorrow.
